DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about a bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このページの印字が薄くて、残高の数字が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い残高印字を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The printing on this page is faint, and I can't read the balance figures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about faintly printed balance figures. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分か拝見します。ほかのページも同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see which part it is. Are the other pages the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前のページは読めます。この三行だけ薄く、最後の桁が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前頁正常と三行末桁不読を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can read the previous page. Only these three lines are faint, and I can't see the last digit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the previous page is fine but the last digits on three lines are unreadable. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が記録を確認して、読める形でのご案内を検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the records and consider how to provide the information in a readable form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。数字を推測して書き写すと、家の記録と合わなくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 推測転記を避け読める記録案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. If I copy the figures by guessing, they won't match my records at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid copying guessed figures and ask for guidance on obtaining a readable record. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの窓口で確認します。いつ記帳なさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check at this counter. When did you update the bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日、入口の機械です。記帳前にはこのページは空白でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日入口機記帳と事前空白を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today, at the machine by the entrance. This page was blank before I updated it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you updated it today at the entrance machine and that the page had been blank. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機械の状況も係が確認します。通帳はこちらでお預かりしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check the machine's condition too. May we hold on to your bankbook here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。読めない三行を示したので、確認が終わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳を渡し三行確認を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've indicated the three unreadable lines, so I'll wait until the check is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the bankbook and say you will wait for the three lines to be checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当者からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. A staff member will explain the results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示についてお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I help you with the labeling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このジャムの開封後の保存方法が小さくて読めません。どこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい開封後保存表示の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The instructions for storing this jam after opening are too small for me to read. Where are they written?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the small-print storage instructions for after opening are located. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ふたの横の表示です。こちらの拡大鏡をお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are on the label beside the lid. You may use this magnifying glass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。開封後は冷蔵と読めました。賞味期限の数字は底ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拡大で冷蔵表示を読み期限印字位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I could read that it must be refrigerated after opening. Are the best-before date figures on the bottom?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the refrigeration instructions with magnification and ask where the date is printed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、底に印字されています。瓶を持ってご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it is printed on the bottom. Please hold the jar to check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 底の数字も見えました。家の冷蔵庫に入れられるよう、小さい瓶を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限を読み冷蔵庫に入る小瓶を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I could see the figures on the bottom too. I'll choose a small jar so that it fits in my fridge at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the date and ask for a small jar that fits in the refrigerator. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい瓶は、この味のほかに二種類ございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Besides this flavor, we have two other varieties in small jars.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このいちごにします。大きい瓶ではなく、今見た小さい方を一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: いちご小瓶一個を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take this strawberry one. I'll buy one of the small jars I just looked at, rather than a large jar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one small jar of strawberry jam. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拡大鏡は、この台へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return the magnifying glass to this stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻しました。保存方法と期限を自分で読めたので、安心して選べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拡大鏡を返し保存期限を読んで購入判断したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've returned it. I could read the storage instructions and date myself, so I was able to choose with confidence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the magnifying glass and say that reading the storage instructions and date helped you decide to buy. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集合場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the meeting point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠足で集まります。案内には晴れなら広場、雨なら屋根の下と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 晴雨別の遠足集合場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We're meeting for an outing. The guide says the plaza if it's sunny, and under the roof if it's raining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the outing's meeting points for sunny and rainy weather. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の集合は広場です。主催の方が、向こうに立っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today's meeting is in the plaza. The organizer is standing over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は降っていませんね。先に屋根の下へ行くところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 晴天広場と屋根下へ向かいかけたことを話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's not raining today. I was about to go under the roof first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the plaza in fine weather and that you were about to head under the roof. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場へは、この道を真っすぐお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: To reach the plaza, go straight along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い旗の所ですか。子どもが途中で迷わないよう、目印を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青旗を子の目印として尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is it by the blue flag? I'd like to know a landmark so my child doesn't get lost along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the blue flag as a landmark for your child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、青い旗です。主催の方も名札を着けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, the blue flag. The organizer is also wearing a name tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旗と名札を確かめます。帰りの集合も同じ所か、主催の方に聞いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旗名札を確認し帰り集合は主催へ聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the flag and name tag. I'll ask the organizer whether we meet at the same place for the return journey too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the flag and name tag and say you will ask the organizer about the return meeting point. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰りの予定は主催の方の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the organizer's instructions for the return schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず広場へ行き、参加の受付と帰りの集合を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場で参加受付と帰り予定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll go to the plaza first and ask about participant registration and where to meet for the return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about participant registration and return arrangements at the plaza. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、遠足をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の前で、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having some trouble at the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 茨木まで行くつもりで切符を買いましたが、案内板に似た名前が二つあります。どちらの列車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た行先表示から乗る列車を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought a ticket intending to go to Ibaraki, but there are two similar names on the information board. Which train should I take?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which train to take given the similar destination displays. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お手元の切符を拝見できますか。駅名の後ろの文字も読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your ticket? Please read the characters after the station name too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 茨木市と書いてあります。私の待ち合わせ先は茨木駅です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券面は茨木市で目的地は茨木駅だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says Ibaraki-shi. My meeting point is Ibaraki Station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the ticket says Ibaraki-shi but your destination is Ibaraki Station. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの駅と茨木駅は別の駅です。相手の方から、路線名も届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This station and Ibaraki Station are different stations. Did the person you're meeting also send you the line name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待ち合わせのメッセージに路線名がありました。この画面を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合せの路線名が記載された画面を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The meeting message included the line name. Could you look at this screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the screen containing the meeting's railway line name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この路線でしたら、ここから直接その切符で行く案内にはなりません。まず購入窓口で切符の変更を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this line, we cannot direct you to travel straight there from here with that ticket. Let's first ask the ticket sales counter about changing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅名の最後を見落としていました。変更を相談してから、正しい駅への道順も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符変更後に正しい駅への経路を相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I overlooked the end of the station name. After asking about changing the ticket, I'd also like to ask the route to the correct station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask about the route to the correct station after changing the ticket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入窓口はこちらです。相手の方には、到着が遅れるとお知らせになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ticket sales counter is here. Will you let the person you're meeting know that you will arrive late?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。駅を取り違えたことと、到着時刻は経路が決まってから伝えることを連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取り違えと到着時刻の後報を相手へ連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll tell them I mixed up the stations, and that I'll give them my arrival time once the route is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the other person about the station mix-up and provide your arrival time later. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 窓口へ切符と画面をお持ちください。それでは、お気をつけてお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your ticket and screen to the counter. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の記入はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished writing your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番地までは書きましたが、同じ敷地に三つの建物があります。部屋番号だけでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 複数棟の住宅の住所表記を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've written as far as the street number, but there are three buildings on the same property. Is just the room number enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to write an address for housing with multiple buildings. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物の棟名が分かる資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a document that identifies the building block?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書にはＢ棟二〇三号室とあります。住所欄にＢ棟を入れる場所が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書の棟名と部屋番号を示し記入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract says Building B, Room 203. I don't know where to put Building B in the address field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the building block and room number on the contract and ask where to write them. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この続きに建物名と棟、部屋番号を記入できます。実際に住んでいる棟もＢ棟ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can write the building name, block, and room number after this. Is Building B also the block you actually live in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。入口にもＢと書いてあります。建物名、Ｂ棟、二〇三号室の順に足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際の棟を答え住所の続きを記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. It says B at the entrance too. I'll add the building name, Building B, and Room 203 in that order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the block you actually live in and complete the rest of the address. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書けましたら、こちらで読み上げた住所をお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have written it, please listen while I read the address aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。数字が続くので、番地と部屋番号の間を区切って読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号を区切って読み上げてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. There are consecutive numbers, so could you pause between the street number and the room number when reading?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the street number and room number to be read aloud separately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、番地までを先に読みます。続いて建物名、Ｂ棟、二〇三号室です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll read as far as the street number first. Then come the building name, Building B, and Room 203.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住んでいる住所と合っています。書いた場所も分かったので、この用紙を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読み上げと住所が一致したため用紙を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It matches the address where I live. Now that I also know where to write it, I'll submit this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the form because the address read aloud matches your address. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙をお預かりします。ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take the form. Thank you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の説明を始める前に、聞こえ方で配慮が必要なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we begin explaining the test, do you need any accommodations for your hearing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右耳に補聴器を付けています。外す検査だと、声だけの説明は聞き取りにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 補聴器を外すと音声説明を聞きにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wear a hearing aid in my right ear. If I have to remove it for the test, it is difficult for me to follow an explanation given only by voice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that spoken instructions are hard to hear when you remove your hearing aid. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査中に外す必要があるかは担当者へ確認します。説明は紙でもお渡ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the staff whether you need to remove it during the test. Would you like the explanation on paper too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙でもお願いします。外す前に手順を読んで、分からない所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外す前に紙で手順を読みたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, on paper too, please. I'd like to read the steps before removing it and ask about anything I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to read the steps on paper before removing it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この説明用紙をお読みください。検査中の合図も担当者と決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please read this explanation sheet. You can also agree on signals during the test with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で止めたいときは、手を上げる合図にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査中止希望の手上げ合図を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could we use raising my hand as the signal when I want to stop partway through?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about raising your hand as a signal to request stopping the test. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を担当者へ伝えます。補聴器を置くためのケースはお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff member your preference. Do you have a case to put your hearing aid in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 専用ケースがあります。外すことになったら、自分でそこへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 補聴器の専用ケースを持参したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have its dedicated case. If I need to remove it, I'll put it in there myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought the hearing aid's dedicated case. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が来ました。紙の説明と合図について、一緒に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member is here. Let's discuss the written explanation and signals together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手順のこの部分を先に聞きます。合図が決まってから検査を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明手順と合図を担当者へ確認後に検査を受けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about this part of the procedure first. I'd like to take the test after we have decided on the signals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the test after checking unclear steps and signals with the staff member. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当者へおつなぎします。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll introduce you to the staff member now. This way, please. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店の入口で自転車が盗まれました。店長から預かった防犯映像の媒体を届けに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店長から預かった自転車盗難映像を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A bicycle was stolen at the shop entrance. I've come to deliver the recording medium containing security footage entrusted to me by the manager.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Deliver the bicycle theft footage entrusted to you by the shop manager. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 被害の届出をされた方ですか。それとも、お店の方でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you the person who reported the theft, or are you from the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の従業員です。自転車の持ち主は先ほど届出をしました。私は映像を届けるよう頼まれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 被害者ではなく店の従業員として届けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm an employee of the shop. The bicycle's owner filed a report earlier. I was asked to deliver the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are delivering it as a shop employee, not as the victim. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届出をされた方の名前と、店長の連絡先が分かる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a document showing the name of the person who filed the report and the manager's contact information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店長が書いたこの封筒に入っています。映像は昨日の午後二時から三時までです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡情報入り封筒と録画時間を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's inside this envelope the manager prepared. The footage covers yesterday from two to three in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the envelope containing contact information and state the recording period. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に引き継ぎます。媒体は元の物ですか、複製ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll hand it over to the person in charge. Is the recording medium the original or a copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 複製です。元の録画は店に残しています。渡した媒体を後で返してほしいという店長の希望もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 複製で原本は店にあり媒体返却希望も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's a copy. The original recording remains at the shop. The manager also wants the medium we hand over returned later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a copy, the original is at the shop, and the manager wants the medium returned. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返却の扱いは担当にお伝えします。受領した物が分かるよう、こちらで記録を取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge about the return request. We'll make a record here so it is clear what was received.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 媒体一個と封筒一通ですね。届けたことを店長へ報告するので、担当の部署も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受領物の数を確認し報告用に担当部署を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: One recording medium and one envelope, right? I'll report the delivery to the manager, so please also tell me the department in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the number of received items and ask for the department in charge for your report. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当部署を書いた紙をお渡しします。お届けありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you a paper with the department in charge written on it. Thank you for delivering these. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの筒をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this tube?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。丸めたポスターが入っています。送り状を巻いて貼ると、宛名が裏へ回りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 筒へ送り状を巻くと宛名が読みにくいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It contains a rolled-up poster. If I wrap the shipping label around it, the address seems likely to go around the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that wrapping the shipping label around the tube would make the address hard to read. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 筒の外へ平らな面を作る方法をご案内できます。ふたは固定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can show you how to make a flat surface on the outside of the tube. Are the caps secured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両端をテープで留めました。中身を折りたくないので、筒のまま送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふたを固定済みで筒形を維持したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've taped both ends. I don't want to fold the contents, so I'd like to send it in its tube shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the caps are secured and you want to keep the tube shape. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛名が一面で読めるよう、この添付板を使う方法があります。大きさを合わせてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: One method is to use this attachment board so the address can be read on one surface. Let's check the fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 板はこの向きなら収まりますね。貼る前に重さと料金も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 板の向きを試し料金確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The board fits in this orientation. Before attaching it, I'd also like to know the weight and postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Try the board's orientation and ask to check the postage. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 計量して、この送り方の料金をお伝えします。料金はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll weigh it and tell you the postage for this shipping method. Here is the price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その料金でお願いします。宛名を板に貼ってから、差出人欄を記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提示料金で添付板を使い差出人欄を書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please go ahead at that price. I'll attach the address to the board and then fill in the sender field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the quoted postage, use the attachment board, and fill in the sender field. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 板の端も浮かないように固定できました。ふたを含め外側を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The board's edges are secured so they won't lift either. I'll inspect the outside, including the caps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。筒のまま受け付けてもらえる状態になったら、この方法で送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外装確認後に筒のまま発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. Once it is ready to be accepted in its tube shape, I'll send it using this method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After the outer packaging check, ask to send it in its tube shape. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この状態でお預かりします。お会計をお願いします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll accept it in this condition. Please pay the postage. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は入金のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about a deposit today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。貯めた硬貨を持ってきました。袋が重いので、機械に何回も運ぶより窓口で入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い硬貨を窓口で入金したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've brought coins I've saved. The bag is heavy, so I'd rather deposit them at the counter than carry them to the machine repeatedly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to deposit heavy coins at the counter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓口の硬貨入金は枚数によって手数料が変わります。枚数は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: For coin deposits at the counter, the fee varies with the number of coins. Do you know how many there are?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百枚くらいだと思いますが、正確には数えていません。数えた後に手数料を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 概数を答え計数後の手数料案内を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think about a hundred, but I haven't counted exactly. Can you tell me the fee after counting them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give an approximate number and ask about being told the fee after counting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数える前に、この枚数ごとの料金表をご説明します。計数後に入金を取りやめる場合の扱いもご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before counting, I'll explain this fee table by number of coins. Please also read how it is handled if you cancel the deposit after counting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この範囲なら手数料がかかるのですね。袋一つを計数して、その扱いでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料金表と計数後の扱いを理解し一袋の計数を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So there is a fee for this range. Please count one bag and handle it under those terms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand the fee table and the handling after counting, then request counting one bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでは、こちらのトレーに硬貨を出してください。袋はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please put the coins on this tray. We'll return the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出しました。紙幣は入っていません。入金先はこの通帳の口座です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 硬貨のみのトレーと入金口座を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put them out. There are no banknotes. The destination account is the one in this bankbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the tray containing only coins and identify the deposit account. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 計数は百二十枚です。手数料と、入金される金額をこちらに示しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The count is 120 coins. The fee and the amount to be deposited are shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額を見ました。その手数料で入金します。空いた袋も受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定枚数と手数料を見て入金を承諾する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the amounts. I'll make the deposit at that fee. I'll also take the empty bag back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the confirmed coin count and fee, then agree to the deposit. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入金後の記帳をお渡しします。ご利用ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the bankbook updated after the deposit. Thank you for using our services. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お米の棚をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the rice shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつも五キロを買いますが、今日は歩いて帰るので重さを減らしたいです。二キロの袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩のため五キロから二キロへ量を減らしたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I usually buy five kilograms, but I'm walking home today and want to reduce the weight. Do you have two-kilogram bags?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to reduce the amount from five to two kilograms because you are walking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この銘柄には二キロ袋があります。五キロ袋より一キロ当たりの価格は高くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This brand comes in two-kilogram bags. The price per kilogram is higher than for a five-kilogram bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 価格の違いは分かりました。二キロ袋を一つください。持ちやすい袋にも入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単価差を理解し二キロ袋と持帰り袋を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand the price difference. Please give me one two-kilogram bag. Can you also put it in a bag that is easy to carry?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the unit price difference and ask about a two-kilogram bag and a carrying bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手提げ袋は有料です。米袋の幅に合う大きさはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Carrier bags cost extra. This size fits the width of the rice bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ってきた手提げの幅を比べてもよいですか。入れば、店の袋は買わずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の手提げと米袋の幅を比べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I compare the width with the carrier bag I brought? If it fits, I won't need to buy a shop bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the width of your own carrier bag with the rice bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。こちらの台で合わせてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Please try fitting it on this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 底まで入りました。持ち手も閉じられるので、この手提げで持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際に入れて手提げで持ち帰れると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It went all the way to the bottom. I can close the handles together too, so I'll use this carrier bag to take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Try putting it in and report that you can take it home in your carrier bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お米は二キロ一袋、お店の袋は不要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So that is one two-kilogram bag of rice, with no shop bag needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この一袋で会計をお願いします。次に車で来たときは五キロを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米一袋を購入し店の袋は不要と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please ring up this one bag. Next time I come by car, I'll choose five kilograms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you are buying one bag of rice and do not need the shop's bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。お会計へどうぞ。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please proceed to checkout. Thank you for visiting.
